items.content:
Somebody told me once that doing a thing badly for years still counts —
that it changes how you think even if you never get good. I make four
things and I make them the same way every time and I used to be a little
ashamed of that. I've stopped. Four things you actually make beats a
shelf of cookbooks you read like novels, which is a sentence I should
probably take elsewhere too.

summary: Doing four things badly for years still changed how she thinks
title: The four things
